Include top, sides and underside of cushion as one skin, not foundation. The seat body explicitly excludes these faces.
selection.reason: Thick rounded cushion with wrinkles is supported local active compliant region.

young_modulus.reason: Editable foam-like material prior; never measured.

preview_indent.reason: Bounded user-controlled local displacement for nonphysical preview only. No load test authorized.

soft_regions.reason: Build one coarse covering tetrahedral flex volume, about 5x5x3 vertices, basal vertices attached to seat owner. Bind dedicated preserved native cushion skin with positive barycentric weights and explicit supported offsets if necessary; use the same mapping for owner transforms and visible local indentation. Render-root nonrigid preview must show local displacement relative to undeformed perimeter. The schema test_strategy records potential future test design only; do NOT execute load/unload, recovery, gravity settling or any mj_step in this generation-only run; no physical success is claimed.

native_scale.reason: Uniform scale giving approximately 1.39 m total height from native Z extent; adult-size prior, not measurement.

world_offset.reason: Translate scaled minimum native Z to ground; derived from geometry bounds and scale prior.

review_requirements: Construction inspection only: account for every source face exactly once across rigid owners and dedicated seat_padding skin; retain UV/PBR and neutral surface placement. Inspect the back/arm and cushion/foundation boundaries so coarse threshold cuts do not strand visible upholstery or metal on the wrong owner. Record actual output roots and rest-frame offsets; preserve the three named addition caps.

Use direct static joint transforms only to inspect visible attachment at minimum, middle and maximum declared finite travel for back_recline, height_slide, footrest_extension and caster headings. Inner column, rails and hinge pin must connect the appropriate moving and fixed owners; pad, arms and deferred coverings follow their real owners. Inspect continuous swivel and wheel joints at representative quarter/half/full-turn poses without imposing stops. This is preview construction inspection, not a physical endpoint/contact test; run no dynamics or collision sweep.

Inspect exported joint metadata and MJCF: upper_swivel and all caster roll hinges have limited=false and no range or limits parameter. Preview accumulated angles remain unwrapped and permit targets beyond 2*pi without actuator angle bounds. Resolve each caster's axle using its native flank geometry as already proposed, retaining consistent child-local pivots and visual offsets; joint control must move actual visible wheel faces, not an empty frame.

Construct the declared coarse tetrahedral seat volume and dedicated native skin binding, with basal owner attachment and nonnegative normalized interpolation weights plus documented offsets where needed. Apply a bounded local parameter indentation up to the proposed 0.025 m through that binding; inspect visible displacement relative to the cushion perimeter and correct following under seat swivel/lift. Whole-skin rigid motion alone is insufficient. Do not execute load, gravity-settle, recovery or mj_step tests or report a physical deformation pass.

Save the usable GLB, editable Blender source, scene and interactive metadata promptly, retaining every approved rigid action and active cushion preview with explicit limitations. Publish after construction with physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0. Do not run physics.py, simulate, verify_integration, physical trajectories or physical acceptance/critic loops.

interaction_coverage.label: Upper assembly swivel
interaction_coverage.reason: Vertical column and separate radial base support an unbounded axial bearing prior; all upper descendants follow.

interaction_coverage.label: Raise/lower seat
interaction_coverage.reason: Central column overlap and underside lever support estimated telescoping stroke, not measured gas-lift function.

interaction_coverage.label: Recline back
interaction_coverage.reason: Transverse back-seat attachment and side fitting support independent reclining back prior. Neutral uses existing lean; 90 degree additional opening retained.

interaction_coverage.label: Deploy padded foot support
interaction_coverage.reason: Distinct under-seat pad and visible horizontal rails support sliding rather than invented multi-link folding.

interaction_coverage.label: Caster wheel rolling
interaction_coverage.reason: Rounded low wheel lobes support axle rolling; parallel X axles are provisional editable priors refined from flank geometry. Wheels rotate without accumulated-angle bounds.

interaction_coverage.label: Caster heading adjustment
interaction_coverage.reason: Upper caster attachments support vertical heading DOF; +/-30 degree limited steering is a preview approximation, not an observed physical stop.

interaction_coverage.label: Seat cushion indentation
interaction_coverage.reason: Active dedicated native skin with coarse flex binding and local parameter deformation; no physical load test in authorized scope.

interaction_coverage.label: Additional padded regions
interaction_coverage.reason: Additional soft surfaces preserved but deformation deferred after the active seat-region construction.

deferred_compliance.name: back_padding
deferred_compliance.reason: Head/lumbar/bolster upholstery remains native geometry following back recline; secondary deformation deferred.

deferred_compliance.name: arm_padding
deferred_compliance.reason: Arm pad upholstery follows its metal supports; secondary compression deferred.

deferred_compliance.name: foot_padding
deferred_compliance.reason: Padded front panel follows sliding support; secondary compliance deferred.

deferred_compliance.name: side_covering
deferred_compliance.reason: Seat foundation and side upholstery rigid-follow their actual owner without a material-rigidity claim.

approximation_gaps.reason: Rear/underside inferred native surfaces, coarse casters and opened back seam may remain imperfect. Added inner supports are estimated construction, not observed internal hardware.
Only simple boxes/capsules/cylinders planned; no collision, contact or dynamic tests authorized. Interpenetration and whole-chair ground locomotion are not established.
Only seat pad actively deforms; other upholstery explicitly rigid-follow. Flex and material priors remain untested; parameter indentation is not a simulated result.
